personality: 5 Brutalist Mobile structure with rustic wood/earthy palette
personality_one_liner: An industrial, highly functional bento-style inventory command center built with warm rustic wood and earthy tones.

spacing.rule: Use sharp, rigid bento grids. No accidental empty space. Exposed structural padding.

dont's: No blur or glassmorphism. This is a Brutalist hardware store app. High contrast, raw structural layouts only.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center for the manager to see stats at a glance and jump into quick actions.

states.error: Mono text error block with 'RETRY' button.

screens.layout: Top sticky header with a hard toggle for 'Gestore / Cliente' mode. Below, a bento-style grid: 2 large cards for 'Valore Magazzino' and 'Articoli sotto scorta' featuring oversized Grotesk numbers. Below that, 2 solid quick-action tiles: 'Scan Barcode' and 'Vendita Rapida'.

screens.name: Catalogo
screens.purpose: Search-first inventory browser with robust filtering.

states.empty: Stark mono message 'NESSUN PRODOTTO TROVATO' + reset filters button.
states.error: Error block with bold retry button.

screens.layout: Top bar: sticky search input and scan icon. Category strip (e.g., Utensili, Viti, Elettricità) below it. Main view: 2-column bento grid of products. Each card has a strict 1pt border, product image, Grotesk title, and Mono-spaced price/stock count. Bottom sheet for filtering by Marca/Categoria.

screens.name: Dettaglio Prodotto
screens.purpose: Show full CRUD details and specs of a single item.
screens.layout: Edge-to-edge product image at the top with a vertical gradient scrim and large Grotesk title overlay. Below: a rigid, exposed-border list of specs (BARCODE, MARCA, CATEGORIA, P. ACQUISTO, P. VENDITA, QTA, FORNITORE, NOTE) all aligned left in Mono font. Sticky bottom section with heavy + / - quantity buttons and 'Salva'.

screens.name: Vendita
screens.purpose: Quick POS checkout system for hardware items.

states.empty: Stark mono message 'CARRELLO VUOTO' + large 'INIZIA SCANSIONE' button.

screens.layout: List view of scanned items with exposed dividers. Each row shows item name, QTY adjusters, and subtotal. A massive sticky block at the bottom showing 'TOTALE' in oversized typography and a full-width 'COMPLETA VENDITA' button.

screens.name: Scanner
screens.purpose: Full-screen camera to scan product barcodes.
screens.layout: Full camera view with a brutalist targeting frame (sharp corner brackets, no rounded edges). Raw mono text reading 'IN ATTESA DI BARCODE...' overlaid on a dark semi-transparent block at the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a global state (e.g. Zustand) for 'Mode: Gestore / Cliente'.
When in 'Cliente' mode, STRICTLY hide the following fields across all screens: P. ACQUISTO, FORNITORE, Statistiche/Valore Magazzino, Add/Edit product buttons, and the 'Vendita Rapida' flow.
Use 1pt sharp borders (`borderStrong`) around bento cards and list items to create the Brutalist structural feel. Set all border radii to 0.
Format all numbers (BARCODE, QUANTITÀ, PREZZO, TOTALE) strictly using the `textFontFamily` (IBM Plex Mono) to emphasize the raw/hardware POS aesthetic.
The Home Dashboard should use a bento-style layout with strong dividing lines, avoiding soft spacing or floating cards.
Mock the Excel Import feature with a simple button that populates the Zustand store with dummy hardware data (including the 'product_drill' image URL).
Ensure 'Vendita Rapida' uses a massive sticky CTA at the bottom, per the thumb zone and sticky primary CTA rules.
